purpose: Separate evidence that a distinction was abstracted, that it is causally used, and that the resulting capability is learner-owned rather than scaffold-performed.

burdens.question: Did the learner form a distinction that survives superficial changes and predicts held-out structure?
required_controls: held-out recombination of known factors
novel opaque labels or participant renaming
surface paraphrase or carrier change
matched-cardinality and matched-length controls where relevant
counterexample set that defeats lexical/template retrieval
cross-face or cross-context transfer when the distinction claims face-independence
WITHHOLD allowed and scored separately from guessing
positive_evidence: same inferred relation under irrelevant surface transformations
different inferred relation when a causally relevant coordinate changes
successful reconstruction on withheld factor combinations
explicit residual preserved when two candidate abstractions remain observationally tied
not_sufficient: teacher-state reproduction with visible answer key
self-description that the distinction was learned

burdens.question: Does the learned distinction actually change later admissible cognition or action?
required_controls: prefrozen downstream metric before decisive return
ablation or masking of candidate learner state
targeted intervention on the candidate coordinate
matched baseline with same input budget and executor
reversal or permutation controls for temporal/indexical distinctions
fresh downstream task, query, retrieval, prediction, problem formation, or action choice
positive_evidence: candidate present versus ablated produces a reproducible downstream difference
targeted coordinate intervention produces the predicted directional consequence
irrelevant-coordinate intervention does not produce the same effect
effect survives fresh returned data rather than only replay
not_sufficient: executor route invokes candidate object without behavioral consequence

burdens.question: Is the consequence-bearing capability owned by learner state rather than performed by a teacher, donor, evaluator, or hidden scaffold?
required_controls: capability-specific teacher/donor/scaffold inaccessible at evaluation
generic executor only where required by substrate
cold restart or rehydration from admitted learner state
fresh non-preauthored return remains external
independent evaluator custody or evaluator-hidden answer key for final claim
novel transfer outside the exact teaching carrier
delayed reuse after intervening unrelated work
provenance and successor reconstruction preserved
decoy scaffold or misleading surface cue does not override learner-owned consequence
positive_evidence: matched or improved competence survives capability-specific source removal
learner state can regenerate or rederive the useful abstraction after restart or perturbation
capability changes future behavior without mentor message or teacher object present
fresh transfer succeeds under independent evaluation
contradictory fresh return can reopen or revise the internalized abstraction
not_sufficient: source removal alone under locally authored evaluation
copying teacher structure into serialized state
